title: The EU warns that AI-boosted chemical synthesis is helping European drug gangs develop new "designer" drug precursors that evade existing product blacklists (Michael Peel/Financial Times)
summary: Michael Peel / Financial Times: The EU warns that AI-boosted chemical synthesis is helping European drug gangs develop new “designer” drug precursors that evade existing product blacklists — EU agency chief warns traffickers are tapping new technologies to develop and deliver illegal substances
